body.zh-Hant: 加齊（Ghazi ibn Faisal，1912–1939）是伊拉克國王費薩爾一世的兒子。費薩爾一世於1921年被英國扶上伊拉克王位。1933年9月，費薩爾一世出國就醫期間去世，由加齊繼位；美國國會圖書館法律圖書館的報告稱他缺乏經驗，被認為對政治不感興趣。
body.en: Ghazi ibn Faisal (1912–1939) was the son of King Faisal I of Iraq, whom the British installed as king of Iraq in 1921. In September 1933 Faisal died while out of the country seeking medical treatment and Ghazi succeeded him; the Law Library of Congress report calls him inexperienced and considered not interested in politics.

citations.quote: He was succeeded by his son, Ghazi ibn Faisal (1912 – 1939).
The British then installed him as king of Iraq in 1921.
In September 1933, King Faisal
died while out of the country seeking medical treatment.
He was succeeded by his son, King Ghazi, who was inexperienced
and considered to be not interested in politics.

body.zh-Hant: 加齊在位期間，伊拉克議會於繼位後次年二月通過國防法案，建立徵兵制並擴編軍隊。1935年3月，一批部落向政府提出憲章，關切什葉派多數在議會與司法中代表不足。1936年10月，巴克爾·西德基發動政變，自哈希米手中奪取政府控制權，開啟軍方影響伊拉克政治的模式；西德基翌年遇刺。
body.en: During Ghazi's reign the Iraqi Parliament passed a National Defense Bill in the February after his accession, setting up conscription and an expanded army. In March 1935 a group of tribes presented the government with a charter citing the lack of Shia representation in Parliament and the judiciary. In October 1936 Bakr Sidqi led a coup, seizing control of the government from al-Hashimi and beginning a pattern of military influence in Iraqi politics; Sidqi was assassinated the next year.

citations.quote: The following February, a National Defense Bill was passed by the Parliament
finally setting up the long-discussed system of conscription
establishing an expanded armed forces
a group of tribes met to discuss their grievances
A charter summarizing the issues was presented to the government in March 1935
lack of representation of the Shia majority in the Parliament and judiciary
In October 1936, Bakr Sidqi led a coup d’état
seizing control of the government from al-Hashimi
beginning a pattern of instability and military influence
Sidqi himself was assassinated the next year

body.zh-Hant: 1939年4月，加齊死於汽車事故。他的兒子後來成為費薩爾二世，當時仍是幼童，由堂兄阿卜杜勒·伊拉赫親王出任攝政。報告指出，加齊支持阿拉伯民族主義者，並反對在英國統治下取得權勢的酋長；阿卜杜勒·伊拉赫與首相努里·賽義德則被視為伊拉克民族主義者，主張與英國合作。
body.en: Ghazi died in an automobile accident in April 1939. His son, who became Faisal II, was still a young child, so his cousin Amir Abd al-Ilah became regent. The report says Ghazi had supported Arab nationalists and opposed the sheikhs who had gained powerful positions under the British, whereas Abd al-Ilah and Prime Minister Nuri al-Said were considered Iraqi nationalists who favored cooperation with Britain.

citations.quote: the death of the King Ghazi in an automobile
accident in April 1939.
His son, who became King Faisal II, was still a young child
a cousin, Amir
Abd al Ilah, became regent.
Ghazi had supported Arab nationalists and opposed the sheiks who
had gained powerful positions under the British
Abd al Ilah and Nuri al-Sa’id, the prime minister,
considered Iraqi nationalists and favored cooperation with Britain.

people.name: José Figueroa Alcorta
people.nameZh: 何塞·菲格羅亞·阿爾科塔

body.zh-Hant: 何塞·菲格羅亞·阿爾科塔1860年11月20日生於阿根廷科爾多瓦省的一個傳統家庭，就讀於蒙塞拉特學校與法學院。他的政治生涯始於胡亞雷斯派，這是國家自治黨內的一個派系。1885至1892年間，他在省議會與總統內閣任職，1892年當選國會眾議員。
body.en: José Figueroa Alcorta was born on 20 November 1860 to a traditional family in the province of Córdoba and studied at the Montserrat School and the Faculty of Law. He began his political career as a Juarista, a faction within the National Autonomist Party. Between 1885 and 1892 he held positions in the provincial legislature and the presidential cabinet, and in 1892 he was elected a deputy to the National Congress.

citations.quote: He was born on November 20, 1860, to a traditional family
in the province of Córdoba
the Montserrat School and the Faculty of Law
He began his political career as a Juarista
a faction within the dominant National Autonomist Party
held positions in the provincial legislature and presidential cabinet
between 1885 and 1892, when he was elected deputy to the National Congress

body.zh-Hant: 1895至1898年，他擔任科爾多瓦省省長；任期結束後當選國會參議員。1904年，他與曼努埃爾·金塔納搭檔競選副總統並告成功。阿根廷最高法院的官方介紹稱，他以副總統身分主持了國家參議院。
body.en: From 1895 to 1898 he served as governor of Córdoba, and when his administration ended he was elected senator in the National Congress. In 1904 he successfully ran for vice president on a ticket with Manuel Quintana. The Argentine Supreme Court's official history says that, as vice president, he presided over the national Senate.

citations.quote: From 1895 to 1898 he served as governor of Córdoba
when his administration ended he was elected senator in the National Congress
In 1904 Figueroa successfully ran for vice president
on a ticket with Manuel Quintana
en su carácter de vicepresidente de la Nación
presidió el Senado de la Nación

body.zh-Hant: 百科條目稱，1906年金塔納去世後，他成為總統；最高法院官網則說金塔納因病離職後，他接掌國家行政權，直到任期於1910年10月12日屆滿。條目評價他在任時為黨派目的過度使用聯邦干預，例如1908年動用警察關閉國會特別會期，並與羅克·薩恩斯·培尼亞所屬的黨內派系對抗。
body.en: The encyclopedia entry says that when Quintana died in 1906 Figueroa became president, while the Supreme Court's website says that after Quintana left office through illness he headed the national executive until the term ended on 12 October 1910. The entry judges that his methods included excessive use of federal intervention for party purposes, for example using the police to close the special sessions of Congress in 1908, and that he fought the faction of Roque Sáenz Peña within his party.

citations.quote: When Quintana died in 1906, Figueroa became president.
Tras el alejamiento del cargo de Quintana por enfermedad
quedó al frente del Ejecutivo Nacional
hasta completar el mandato, el 12 de octubre de 1910
excessive use of federal intervention for party purposes
using the police to close the special sessions of Congress in 1908
fighting the faction of Roque Sáenz Peña within his party

body.zh-Hant: 1915年，在維克托里諾·德拉普拉薩政府時期，他被任命為最高法院法官。安東尼奧·貝爾梅霍去世後，他自1929年起主持最高法院，直到1931年12月27日去世為止。法院大樓內的紀念牌稱他「主持過國家的三個權力」。
body.en: In 1915, under the government of Victorino de la Plaza, he was appointed a justice of the Supreme Court. After the death of Antonio Bermejo, he presided over the court from 1929 until his own death on 27 December 1931. A plaque in the courthouse says he presided over the three powers of the state.

citations.quote: En 1915, durante el gobierno de Victorino de la Plaza
fue designado ministro de la Corte Suprema
Tras el fallecimiento de Antonio Bermejo
presidió el cuerpo desde 1929 hasta su propia muerte
el 27 de diciembre de 1931
Presidió los tres poderes del Estado

heading.en: The field of presidential candidates in early 1920

body.zh-Hant: 1920年2月26日，美國駐尼加拉瓜公使在電報中說，「查莫羅總統」表示，若自己不成為候選人，他將首選支持馬丁·貝爾納德，次選迭戈·M·查莫羅。電報同時列出另外兩位重要候選人，並說保守黨黨代表大會將在5月2日召開。
body.en: In a telegram of 26 February 1920 the US Minister in Nicaragua reported that President Chamorro said that if he did not become a candidate he would support Martin Bernard as first choice and Diego M. Chamorro as second. The telegram also named two other prominent candidates and said the Conservative Party convention would meet on May 2.

citations.quote: Managua , February 26, 1920—9 a.m.
The Minister in Nicaragua ( Jefferson ) to the Acting Secretary of State
President Chamorro.
He stated that in the event of his not becoming a candidate
he would support as first choice Martin Bernard and second, Diego M.
Other prominent candidates are J. A. Urtecho and Fernando Solórzano.
The convention of the Conservative Party will meet on May 2.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年5月4日，美國公使從馬拿瓜發電報稱，迭戈·M·查莫羅「昨天」已被保守黨提名為總統候選人。依電報日期與「昨天」一詞，提名發生在5月3日（推論）。
body.en: On 4 May 1920 the US Minister telegraphed from Managua that Diego M. Chamorro had been nominated the day before by the Conservative Party as its presidential candidate. From the date of the telegram and the word 'yesterday' the nomination fell on 3 May (inferred).

citations.quote: The Minister in Nicaragua ( Jefferson ) to the Secretary of State
Managua , May 4, 1920—9 a.m.
Yesterday Diego M. Chamorro was nominated by the Conservative
citations.evidenceNote: 提名日期（5月3日）依電報日期與「Yesterday」推得（推論）

citations.quote: Party as presidential candidate.

body.zh-Hant: 1921年8月30日，美國駐薩爾瓦多公使報告，薩爾瓦多、宏都拉斯與尼加拉瓜之間的關係正迅速惡化。公使向薩爾瓦多總統提議，在美國軍艦上舉行三位總統與他本人的會議；薩爾瓦多總統回說，「查莫羅」曾建議過會面。編者註明這位查莫羅就是尼加拉瓜總統迭戈·M·查莫羅。
body.en: On 30 August 1921 the US Minister in Salvador reported that relations among Salvador, Honduras and Nicaragua were rapidly getting worse. He suggested to the President of Salvador a conference of the three Presidents and himself on board a US vessel; the Salvadoran President replied that Chamorro had suggested a meeting. The editors' footnote identifies this Chamorro as Diego M. Chamorro, President of Nicaragua.

citations.quote: The Minister in Salvador ( Schuyler ) to the Secretary of State
San Salvador , August 30, 1921—midnight .
the relations between Salvador, Honduras and Nicaragua are rapidly getting worse
I suggested to the President to-day after a discussion lasting several hours
conference of three Presidents and myself on board a United States vessel
saying that Chamorro 4 had suggested a meeting
Diego M. Chamorro, President of Nicaragua.
